newsitem.title: USA: Cronos says industry use built in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Cronos says industry use built in Q2.

text.p: Cronos Group said Wednesday industry utilization of its intermodal containers began improving in the first quarter and continued to build in the second quarter.
The company said its fleet was 83 percent utilized in the second quarter ended June 30, an improvement of 6 percent over the last six months.
During the first quarter, combined utilization for the fleet was 77 percent compared with 82 percent for the same period a year ago.
The company said, however, that the first quarter was a "low point" for container utilization.
The company reported a loss per share in the first quarter of $0.08, with a $900,000 charge, compared to a profit of $0.21 for the same period a year ago.
Cronos fleet of dry cargo, refrigerated, tank and other specialized containers is leased to a customer base of around 300 ocean carriers and transport operators.
